run_nll_evaluation: run negative log-likelihood evaluation on a trained model checkpoint using the CLI nll command
run_visualize_command: run the visualize command to generate visualizations from a model checkpoint on test data
run_visualize_all_data: run the visualize command with the --all flag to visualize the entire test dataset
load_model_from_checkpoint: load a trained manifold flow matching model and its config from a checkpoint file
test_model_with_lightning: test a model using PyTorch Lightning trainer to compute test metrics on a test loader
